laws.heading: Lei 12.155/2023
laws.rule: Mato Grosso state Lei 12.155 of 19 June 2023 bans selling, storing, transporting, handling, using and letting off loud-bang fireworks and any noisy pyrotechnic device across the state, indoors or outdoors, on public or private land. Sight-only fireworks (visual effect, no bang) are excepted. Cargo passing through from another state to a third is allowed if it is not stored in Mato Grosso, even briefly.
laws.penalty_signal: fine of 200 to 3,000 UPF/MT; doubled on the first repeat and quadrupled from the second (a repeat means the same breach within 30 days)

public_holidays: 2027-11-20 (Saturday): Dia Nacional da Consciência Negra / anniversary of the death of Zumbi dos Palmares, a state holiday under Lei 7.879 of 27 December 2002, article 1. The same date is also a national holiday. This record does not check whether later state amendments changed Lei 7.879.
culture-cycles.note: Lei 7.879/2002, read from the official Diário Oficial do Estado de Mato Grosso of 27 December 2002 (ALMT official storage PDF). Article 2 brings the law into force on publication and repeals contrary provisions. Municipal holidays and later optional office days (pontos facultativos) are not covered. Because 20 November 2027 falls on a Saturday, private-sector observance that year may follow national weekend rules; this record does not restate those national rules.
